item.text: I’ll inspect the module and trace the relevant behavior enough to distinguish actual bugs from stylistic concerns.

The module provides order helpers: calculate totals, apply `SAVE10`/`SAVE20` discounts, compute average item price, and format an order summary.

Bugs in [orders.js](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-Xa6u83/test/orders.js:5):

- `calcTotal` uses `i <= items.length`. On the final iteration, `items[i]` is `undefined`, causing a `TypeError`. It should use `i < items.length`.
- `averageItemPrice([])` divides by zero. After fixing `calcTotal`, an empty array would return `NaN`; it should explicitly define or reject the empty-list case.
- Because `averageItemPrice` and `formatOrder` call `calcTotal`, they currently fail for every input.
